explain: Moving the KV-head control in this toy redraws the cache curve as cache = n_kv x L past the threshold line, with readout n_kv = value from arXiv 2305.13245. More queries share one key-value so cache grows with KV heads, which only holds if the threshold line stays still.

questions.q: Predict which queries share one key when KV heads set to 2?
Why does KV cache stay flat when query heads rise to 32?

title: KV heads set cache, queries share keys
